subject: Chemistry
b6_reason: N2 + H2 to NH3 over finely divided (solid) iron is catalysis where the catalyst phase differs from the gaseous reactants, i.e. heterogeneous catalysis; the other three (NO gas with SO2/O2, NO gas with ozone, H+ ions in solution) are all homogeneous catalysis since catalyst and reactants share one phase.
